notes.title: ☪️ TSUNDERE MILFIN — Update 1.15 is live!
notes.notes:

[b]🆕 Update 1.15 is now available in-game![/b]

A fresh update has just been released for our beloved office sim — check it out now! 

Version 1.15 adds a brand [b]new situation[/b] on the map that brings even more intrigue to your workdays. You’ll also find [b]2 fully animated scenes[/b] and 1 minigame waiting for you. 🔥 ːfuhrer_heartː

To access the new content, you’ll need the Strange Coin. 🪙
What happens if you use it? Who knows… but HR is already watching. 😳

Just one rule:
NO RUNNING ON THE STAIRS!

notes.title: ✟My Cute Succubus✟ UI & Localization update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034061/05ef8300df3d3c97aad688fa759ade0fb1badfcc.png[/img]

ːorange_heartː[b]Hey Kitties[/b],ːorange_heartː

[b]✟My Cute Succubus✟[/b] get new update! Your reviews and feedback helps us a lot. We received from you an idea to simplify navigation in GIRLS MODE and GALLERY. It is now available in the game! Express your opinion and write to us with your ideas.

We also fixed the problem with stumbling text in the dialog box. Dialogue reading should now be smoother and more enjoyable ːfuhrer_heartː

We've made many more small fixes. Now there should be a negligible amount of bugs. But be sure to inform us if any mistake catches your eye. It will definitely be fixed in the next update ːfuhrer_teaː

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1719660/extras/MCS1.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034061/fa027dc05b367f202bef5adcc96b7ccc3a8bc43d.png[/img]

[b]Finally[/b], our cute [b]Spanish[/b]-speaking kitties and our adorable [b]Portuguese[/b]-speaking kittens can enjoy playing in native language! ːfuhrer_lovingː

This is the first experience of translating games into these marvellous languages. Be sure to let us know if you find any typos or errors.


Thank you for your interest in our games. It is very important for us ːcatgirl_loveː

notes.title: ✟My Cute Succubus✟ Halloween update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034061/e6e3cfa155f527c7747c279b7141315d125fd305.png[/img]

[b]Kitties[/b], we released an update that fixed several small bugs, updated the gallery functionality, added the ability to disable all NSFW content in DLC. Now you can immerse yourself in Hell in total comfort! ːAnnaOK_nvlː

[h1][b]ːfuhrer_heartːDisable NSFW content function!ːfuhrer_heartː[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034061/47677af785b704ed5f57e19cfb81307c06e1795e.gif[/img]

Have you wanted to play [b]✟My Cute Succubus✟[/b] at work? Or did you want to show this wonderful novel to your [b]grandmom[/b]? Or maybe you just wanted to stream on [b]YouTube[/b] or [b]Twitch[/b]? Previously, you could not do this, because in DLC the girls the girls tried to take off something from themselves. Now it's over! Just uncheck this little checkbox in the settings and the girls will never look provocative again. Enjoy the game story with your family and colleagues!

[h1]ːfuhrer_heartːHiding UI!ːfuhrer_heartː[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034061/a221e8ffe0b0cadf4efc0d6cc417cb84a44cc488.png[/img]
Do you want to enjoy the [b]Succubus[/b], [b]Teresa[/b] or [b]Stalin[/b] wihtout UI? [b]Press F[/b] on your keyboard to hide this [b]annoying interface[/b]! Now you can... Um... for example, make a nice screenshot or something...

We've also made a few changes in backgrounds ahead of Halloween. Now Hell is even more Hellish. 
Hope you enjoy it.ːcatgirl_loveː
